I read this in a paper about DCG film making and tryed it. 

Rollison

"Coat and examine uniformity by looking for local fringe patterns under a fluorescent lamp or better yet a fluorescent long wave black light. "

It does seem to work in as you can see Newton's rings simular as if you sqeezed two pieces of glass together. But what I didn't know was what to look for. Idealy would the fringes be straight lines? If not what do they mean? I.e if I see an area with tight rings does it mean thicker thinner or just a delta? Seems like a useful tool but not sure how to use it.
